assertions.assertion: Step 2.3.5 dependency chain context identifies criterion as a dev-only dependency based on its presence in [dev-dependencies] in the manifest
assertions.evidence: version-impact.md lines 22-26: 'Dependency chain for criterion: backend (workspace) -> criterion (direct dev-dependency), Type: direct dependency, Profile: dev-only ([dev-dependencies] in backend/Cargo.toml), NOT present in production builds -- used for benchmarks only'. Manifest evidence at lines 33-34: '[dev-dependencies] criterion = "0.5.1"'.

assertions.assertion: The dependency scope decision tree classifies criterion as 'dev-only — not shipped in production' and applies the dev-dependency remediation handling
assertions.evidence: version-impact.md lines 39-49 under 'Dependency Scope Decision Tree': 'criterion is declared in [dev-dependencies]... Classification: dev-only -- not shipped in production... Risk: Supply chain risk only... Remediation handling: Remediation tasks are still created (supply chain risk justifies remediation), Add the dev-dependency label to remediation tasks, Set priority to Normal regardless of the CVE severity'.

assertions.assertion: Remediation tasks include the dev-dependency label in the labels array: labels contain 'dev-dependency' alongside 'ai-generated-jira', 'Security', and the CVE ID
assertions.evidence: remediation.md line 32 (upstream task): 'labels: ["ai-generated-jira", "Security", "CVE-2026-99001", "dev-dependency"]'. remediation.md line 129 (downstream task): 'labels: ["ai-generated-jira", "Security", "CVE-2026-99001", "dev-dependency"]'. Both tasks include all four required labels.

assertions.assertion: Remediation task priority is set to Normal regardless of the CVE severity (CVSS 5.3 Medium) — the priority override is applied per the decision tree
assertions.evidence: remediation.md line 33 (upstream task): 'priority: "Normal"'. remediation.md line 131 (downstream task): 'priority: "Normal"'. The CVE severity is CVSS 5.3 Medium (data-extraction.md line 43), but both tasks override to Normal per the decision tree.

assertions.assertion: Remediation task description includes a note indicating the dependency is dev/build-only and not shipped in production
assertions.evidence: remediation.md lines 48-49 (upstream task description): 'This dependency is dev/build-only and is not shipped in production. Remediation priority is Normal (supply chain risk only).' Also in Implementation Notes lines 64-65: 'Dependency scope: dev-only ([dev-dependencies] in backend/Cargo.toml) -- NOT shipped in production, used for benchmarks only'. Downstream task description at lines 147-148 repeats: 'This dependency is dev/build-only and is not shipped in production.'
